answer: Markus Hinterhäuser was placed on leave until September 30, 2026, by the Salzburg Festival on March 26, 2026. FINAL: Markus Hinterhäuser

hits.text: 26 March – The board of directors of the Salzburg Festival announce the termination of the contract of Markus Hinterhäuser as artistic director of the festival, placing him on leave until 30 September 2026.
7 April – The Salzburg Festival announces the appointment of Karin Bergmann as its interim artistic director, with immediate effect, the first woman to serve as the festival's artistic director.
16 May – Germany finishes 23rd at Eurovision 2026 in Austria.
16 February – The San Antonio Philharmonic announces the cancellation of the remaining concerts of its 2025-2026 season.
27 May – 2026 UEFA Conference League final in Leipzig.
